recentItems.title: An unexpected friendship grows in prison
recentItems.description:
All you need is one person you can rely on. 

#TimeBBC #DavidTennant #Drama #SiobhanFinneran  

A tragedy shakes a Young Offenders Institution, exposing the pressures faced by both inmates and staff. As chaplain Marie-Louise (#SiobhanFinneran) grapples with a crisis of faith, she clashes with experienced officer Bailey (#DavidTennant), who may be hiding the truth behind what really happened.
